question: The interface vocabulary has no token for a VPN tunnel, WireGuard, OpenVPN or a SOCKS5 proxy endpoint. Which terms should be added (for example wireguard, openvpn, socks5, vpn-tunnel)?
why: Eight new VPN records use unknown (or cli where a command-line client exists) and name the true protocols in interface_detail, so they sort with records that have no interface.
